propositions: Link-sync tests currently exercise only a single representative relation (blocks) instead of the full relation vocabulary, leaving gaps in coverage for other relations like depends_on.

An outbound depends_on link direction bug (c8ed) shipped because the test suite lacked parametrization over all relations and relied on mechanical stub assertions rather than semantic round-trip validation.
The test_link_dedup.py test must be parametrized to assert exact (jira_type, swap) tuples for all mapped relations and empty mutations for unmapped relations.

The test_link_removal_sync.py test must cover the untested REMOVE case where an outward Blocks link exists in Jira but its local depends_on dependency was removed, validating the direction logic at outbound_links.py lines 193-202.
